desc_en: The contemporary silhouette redefines daily luxury with a refined and essential design. Raglan lines structure the form with fluidity and precision. Deep black absorbs light and projects a magnetic presence. Each piece is crafted on demand to ensure exclusivity and absolute precision. Available with worldwide shipping to accompany any destination with distinction.

Disponible con envíos a todo el mundo para acompañar cualquier destino con distinción.
